paraphrase: Through many births I wandered in saṃsāra seeking the house-builder; painful is birth again and again. House-builder, you are seen! You will not build a house again; all your rafters are broken, the ridge-pole shattered; the mind has gone to the unconditioned, it has reached the destruction of cravings.
